titleEs: D4Paragon vs D4 Planner — specialist vs all-purpose
titleEn: D4Paragon vs D4 Planner — specialist vs all-purpose
descriptionEs: Dos planners para D4 con scope distinto: D4Paragon solo paragon system; D4 Planner es full build planner (skills + paragon + gear).
descriptionEn: Two D4 planners with different scope: D4Paragon paragon-only; D4 Planner is a full build planner (skills + paragon + gear).
verdictEs: D4 Planner para crear full build desde scratch. D4Paragon para optimization granular del paragon system cuando ya tienes skills y gear definidos. Complementarios en workflow serious.
verdictEn: D4 Planner to create a full build from scratch. D4Paragon for granular paragon system optimization when you already have skills and gear defined. Complementary in serious workflow.

useCases.reasonEs: D4 Planner cubre skills + paragon + gear + aspects en una sola tool. D4Paragon solo cubre paragon system.
useCases.reasonEn: D4 Planner covers skills + paragon + gear + aspects in a single tool. D4Paragon only covers the paragon system.

useCases.reasonEs: D4Paragon es focused only en paragon: UI más detallada para board rotations, glyph placement, rare nodes. D4 Planner es general purpose.
useCases.reasonEn: D4Paragon focused only on paragon: more detailed UI for board rotations, glyph placement, rare nodes. D4 Planner is general purpose.

useCases.reasonEs: D4 Planner permite comparar dos full builds. D4Paragon solo compara paragon configurations.
useCases.reasonEn: D4 Planner allows comparing two full builds. D4Paragon only compares paragon configurations.

useCases.reasonEs: Respec paragon es expensive. D4Paragon te permite mockear changes específicos al board sin abrir un planner full.
useCases.reasonEn: Paragon respec is expensive. D4Paragon lets you mock specific board changes without opening a full planner.

useCases.reasonEs: D4 Planner tiene UI general que players use across múltiples build planners. D4Paragon focus en paragon requires understanding del system específico.
useCases.reasonEn: D4 Planner has a general UI players use across multiple build planners. D4Paragon's paragon focus requires understanding the specific system.
